tutorial.info: Your remaining chips, the round net, and cards left appear here.
tutorial.layout: The A–K layout. Tap a rank to place a chip. Turn on Copper to bet that the rank will lose.
tutorial.deal: Turn two cards with this button. The first (losing) card is collected by the bank; the second (winning) card pays you 1:1.
tutorial.call: The final three cards can be called by predicting their order — a correct call pays 4:1.
tutorial.resetButton: Use this button to reset the game at any time.
